# MedCare MSO

> AI-powered medical billing, revenue cycle management, and healthcare operations platform delivering 98.5% clean-claim rates and 35% revenue lift.

MedCare MSO is a comprehensive healthcare technology and services company specializing in medical billing, EHR integration, and revenue cycle management. The platform combines AI-driven automation with specialized billing services across multiple healthcare settings including hospitals, physician practices, laboratories, and imaging centers.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing Services
- AI Medical Coding
- HIPAA Compliance
- Claims Processing
- EHR Integration
- CPT & ICD-10 Coding
- Accounts Receivable Recovery
- AI Medical Scribe
- Practice Management (PMS)
- Healthcare Outsourcing
- EDI & CMS Compliance
- Robotic Process Automation
- Healthcare Data Analytics
- MedCare Force Staffing
